text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's grand ambition: "Challenging the Impossible."
In other words, winning a European G1 for the first time ever and inspiring people all across the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now that we've decided to skip the Prix Maurice
de Gheest, the only way to achieve that is to beat
Taiki Shuttle in the Prix Jacques Le Marois."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: But—is that truly possible?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd like to hear your assessment first.
I'm sure you've considered every possible angle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if I were to enter the Prix Jacques le Marois...
is there really a strategy where I beat Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought about it over and over again.
How to defeat Taiki Shuttle.
And the answer I arrived at is—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Impossible...? What's your reason for that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Let me explain. First is the "difference in ability."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Seeking the Pearl acknowledges,
Taiki Shuttle's mile-running prowess is truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have to admit she has the upper hand right now.
And on top of that... there are the "course conditions."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘The deep European turf.’ ‘The soft ground.’
Everything is stacked far too heavily in their favor.
And on top of that—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The environment? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to Sirius Symboli's intel...
there is a significant difference between the facilities
in France and those at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To defeat Taiki Shuttle despite the gap in ability, a precise training plan is essential. However, in an unfamiliar environment, executing it is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Considering the points above...
choice_data_list: No matter how you think about it, it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... it's impossible, then...
If you say so, then I suppose it must be.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I also felt it was impossible.
Though for an entirely different reason than yours.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the reason why I think I cannot beat Taiki
in the Prix Jacques Le Marois.
That is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Destiny... Fate itself.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just as I have my destiny,
Taiki has hers as well...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "I feel a strong connection. Between Taiki and the Prix Jacques le Marois."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Most likely, this is a fateful race for her. And—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if you can overcome your own destiny,
I don't feel a wave strong enough
to alter Taiki's fate as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's my opinion. Looking at it from either perspective,
it seems impossible to beat Taiki in the Jacques Le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Even so, if you still intend to run... you must run prepared for defeat."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running even when you know you will lose.
Perhaps there is beauty in that.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl doesn't run to show
the world disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there any way?
Without running away from Taiki Shuttle,
a way to show hope to the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, there's no way I can beat
the current Taiki. I have no choice
but to concede the first European G1 victory."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then what can I do? If I missed my chance for a maiden victory,
what should I do to prove my potential
goes far beyond that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki will surely become a world champion.
Should I just keep singing her praises forever?
Or...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I listened to Seeking the Pearl's monologue,
an image sprang to mind. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we yield the first conquest, we must seize even greater glory in the future.
That is the only way to demonstrate hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll surpass those I can't beat right now,
and reach even higher――!"
choice_data_list: I can see the path now, Pearl

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is there "another" route?
choice_data_list: Let's take on Taiki Shuttle right here at home!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Take her on? You mean Taiki, who just made her triumphant return?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Get even stronger in the sprint division.
Yeah. I'll get even stronger, and prove it in the sprints...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Knowing how tough Taiki Shuttle is, after her overseas expedition, it's entirely possible she'll run in domestic races for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told them it's entirely plausible she will enter the 'Sprinters Stakes' in the fall.
Assuming the conditions are a domestic 1200m...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes! ...I see.
If she's going to run in that—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Depending on our enhancement plan, we can stand up to her.
And if I defeat Taiki, who conquered the world...!
choice_data_list: Ah, we can prove your potential!
Yeah, we can prove your potential!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even if they're out of my league right now, they won't stay out of my league forever."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if we concede the first championship, all we have to do is beat that world champion. And from there, fly out into the world and achieve great things...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —It won't be easy. In fact, it might be even harder than cleverly gunning for our first European GⅠ victory...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's the only way!
Without running away, we must show our potential to the world!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. My first overseas GⅠ victory...
Let us bid farewell to my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Goodbye, my glory...
Let's meet again someday, somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm letting go of the dream I've held onto for so long.
Instead, I'm aiming for an even greater glory!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, this choice is—merely the start of a brand-new destiny.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
By starting over, I'll aim even higher!
To do that, first...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I will defeat the world-conquering Taiki
in the Sprinters Stakes!
I must keep going down this path!"
